capabilities: Turn notes or editor selections into flashcards by tag or folder
Schedule reviews with FSRS and rate recall as Again, Hard, Good, or Easy
Show a review list of due cards and tests sorted by urgency
Generate multiple-choice tests from flashcards with OpenAI, DeepSeek, or a local AI server
Revise generated tests from natural-language instructions while preserving review progress
extras: Privacy note: flashcard review is local-only, but AI generation and editing send the source card content to the selected provider; there is no automatic fallback between AI providers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition, so users have no native way to schedule note reviews or generate quizzes from their notes.

relations.evidence: MemMaster uses FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) through the ts-fsrs package.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible local AI server (Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI, llama.cpp)

summary: Spaced repetition plugin that turns notes into flashcards with FSRS scheduling and generates multiple-choice tests from them using AI providers.
